message.content:
Since \(\mathbf b\) bisects the angle between \(\mathbf a\) and \(\mathbf c\), the direction of \(\mathbf c\) is the reflection of \(\mathbf a\) across the line spanned by \(\mathbf b\).

The reflection of \(\mathbf a\) across \(\mathbf b\) is
\[
\mathbf r=2\frac{\mathbf a\cdot \mathbf b}{\mathbf b\cdot \mathbf b}\mathbf b-\mathbf a.
\]
Compute:
\[
\mathbf a\cdot \mathbf b=7(3)+(-1)(1)+4(2)=28,
\]
\[
\mathbf b\cdot \mathbf b=3^2+1^2+2^2=14.
\]
Thus
\[
\mathbf r=2\cdot \frac{28}{14}\mathbf b-\mathbf a=4\mathbf b-\mathbf a.
\]
So
\[
\mathbf r=4\begin{pmatrix}3\\1\\2\end{pmatrix}-\begin{pmatrix}7\\-1\\4\end{pmatrix}
=\begin{pmatrix}5\\5\\4\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Therefore
\[
\mathbf c=\lambda\begin{pmatrix}5\\5\\4\end{pmatrix}.
\]

Also, the points with position vectors \(\mathbf a,\mathbf b,\mathbf c\) are collinear, so
\[
\mathbf c=\mathbf a+t(\mathbf b-\mathbf a)
=\begin{pmatrix}7\\-1\\4\end{pmatrix}
+t\begin{pmatrix}-4\\2\\-2\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}7-4t\\-1+2t\\4-2t\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Set this equal to \(\lambda(5,5,4)\):
\[
7-4t=5\lambda,\qquad -1+2t=5\lambda,\qquad 4-2t=4\lambda.
\]
From the first two equations,
\[
7-4t=-1+2t \implies 8=6t \implies t=\frac43.
\]
Then
\[
7-4\cdot \frac43=5\lambda \implies \frac53=5\lambda \implies \lambda=\frac13.
\]
Hence
\[
\mathbf c=\frac13\begin{pmatrix}5\\5\\4\end{pmatrix}
=\begin{pmatrix}\frac53\\[2pt]\frac53\\[2pt]\frac43\end{pmatrix}.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}\frac53\\[2pt]\frac53\\[2pt]\frac43\end{pmatrix}}\).
